presentations.title: 🚀 Autonomy Unleashed: Agent Framework and the New Age of AI Agents 🤖✨
presentations.abstract: Step into the future of AI! In this dynamic session, we'll explore how Microsoft Agent Framework empowers a new generation of agentic AI — systems that don't just respond, but reason, plan, and act.

presentations.title: The Age of Coding Agents: How AI is Rewriting the Way We Build Software
presentations.abstract: AI is no longer your autocomplete — it is your coding agent. This keynote explores the three pillars of the Coding Agent revolution: GHCP Modernization CLI, Squad multi-agent teams, and Spec2Cloud.

presentations.title: Radius: The Open-Source Platform for Cloud-Native Application Development
presentations.abstract: Radius is Microsoft's open-source platform that provides a unified application model across clouds — letting developers define what their app needs while platform engineers define how those needs are fulfilled.

presentations.title: Autonomy in Production: Building Reliable Multi-Agent Systems with .NET Aspire
presentations.abstract: Building multi-agent systems is exciting — running them reliably in production is the real challenge. This session explores how to take multi-agent architectures from prototype to production using .NET Aspire.

presentations.title: Spec-Driven Development with GitHub Copilot & Spec2Cloud: From Idea to Cloud
presentations.abstract: A full-day hands-on workshop covering the complete Spec-Driven Development workflow using GitHub Copilot and Spec2Cloud — both Greenfield and Brownfield scenarios.

presentations.title: Level Up your Repository with Agentic AI: Spec-Driven Development with GitHub Copilot
presentations.abstract: Learn how to level up your repository by introducing a spec-first workflow powered by GitHub Copilot and Spec2Cloud, plus Squads for multi-agent development.

presentations.title: Autonomy Unleashed: Multi-Agent Systems from MAF Orchestration to Squads
presentations.abstract: From structured orchestration with Microsoft Agent Framework to the Squads paradigm: composable, squad-based workflows where specialized agents tackle complex tasks together.

presentations.title: GitHub Copilot Deep Dive: From Zero to Hero with AI-Powered Development
presentations.abstract: GitHub Copilot in 2026 is an autonomous coding agent, code reviewer, test generator, and documentation writer. This demo-driven session goes from zero to hero in 60 minutes.

presentations.title: Agentic Modernization: Transforming Legacy Applications with GitHub Copilot CLI
presentations.abstract: GitHub Copilot CLI turns modernization on its head: scanning legacy code, generating migration proposals, executing refactoring autonomously. Drawing on real enterprise programs with 150+ applications.

presentations.title: Agentic Modernization Lab: Hands-On Legacy Transformation with GitHub Copilot
presentations.abstract: Hands-on lab where participants modernize a legacy .NET Framework application using Copilot CLI agent mode: analysis, planning, refactoring, testing, and validation.

presentations.title: MAFSpire: Building Production AI Agents with Microsoft Agent Framework & .NET Aspire
presentations.abstract: Full-day workshop combining MAF for building intelligent agents and .NET Aspire for running them reliably in production with full observability.

presentations.title: AI + Platform Engineering: Building Developer Platforms with Radius and Intelligent Agents
presentations.abstract: How intelligent agents can both consume and extend developer platforms, with Radius providing the foundation for agent-friendly infrastructure.

presentations.title: GitHub Copilot Deep Dive: Mastering AI-Assisted Development
presentations.abstract: Going beyond basic autocomplete: context-aware completions, slash commands, workspace agents, custom instructions. Techniques that measurably improve your daily workflow.

presentations.title: MEO: Building an AI-Powered Techco — From Telco to Intelligent Platform
presentations.abstract: MEO (Altice Portugal) transforms from traditional telco to AI-powered Techco: AI across network optimization, predictive maintenance, customer experience, and autonomous operations.

presentations.title: Cloud Careers: Navigating Your Path in the AI-Powered Cloud Era
presentations.abstract: Panel discussion on career paths in cloud computing, skills that matter in 2026, how AI is changing the cloud engineer role, and practical advice for professionals.

presentations.title: Unleashing AI Agents: Building Intelligent Systems with Microsoft Agent Framework
presentations.abstract: Design, build, and deploy AI agents using Microsoft Agent Framework — from single-agent patterns to sophisticated multi-agent orchestrations in production.

presentations.title: Orleans: Building Distributed Applications with Virtual Actors
presentations.abstract: Microsoft Orleans makes distributed systems dramatically simpler with the Virtual Actor model. From fundamentals to production patterns: grains, state, streams, and cluster management.

presentations.title: Cloud Native Innovation: Building the Next Generation of Applications on Azure
presentations.abstract: Cloud-native in 2026: intelligent applications leveraging AI, event-driven architectures, serverless compute, and platform engineering on Azure.

presentations.title: AI at the Frontier: Panel Discussion on the Future of Intelligent Software
presentations.abstract: Panel on the frontier of AI in software development — coding agents, multi-agent systems, responsible AI, and the evolving role of the human developer.

presentations.title: AKS Deep Dive: Advanced Kubernetes Patterns on Azure
presentations.abstract: Advanced AKS patterns: cluster architecture, networking, security, scaling, observability, GitOps, AI/GPU workloads, and multi-cluster fleet management.
